blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Text, images, audio, touch, and even robot actions can, in principle, all be rendered onto a single canvas, suggesting an ambitious goal of unifying all modalities within vision. Language provides the natural first test. To subsume it, a visual model must reason directly over text in pixels. Across a wide range of image, video, and unified multimodal generators, however, we find that their visual generation modules cannot perform symbolic reasoning over text on the canvas. They succeed only when an underlying text module or prompt rewriter already supplies the answer, effectively reducing the generator to a mere renderer, a limitation that post-training does little to resolve. To test whether this failure stems from pixels themselves or from current training paradigms, we train a family of purely pixel-space generative models from scratch without any text pathway. With images as their sole input and output, these models read questions, write intermediate steps, and produce answers directly on the canvas. Remarkably, they exhibit hallmark behaviors of large language models. Performance improves predictably with scale following a power law. Writing intermediate steps frame by frame substantially outperforms single-frame answering, echoing chain-of-thought, while reinforcement-learning post-training further strengthens reasoning. Moreover, sharing one canvas allows the same model to reason across modalities, a capability that text-only language models lack. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first systematic study of these phenomena in purely pixel-space generative models free of text tokens.
blocks.zh: 文字,图像,音频,触摸,甚至机器人行动,原则上都可以被展示到一个单一的画布上,提出一个宏大的目标,在视觉中统一所有模式. 语言提供了自然的第一测试. 要包含它,视觉模型必须直接在文字上以像素来解释. 然而,我们发现,在各种图像、视频和统一的多模式生成器中,它们的视觉生成模块不能对画布上的文字进行象征性的推理。 只有当一个基本的文本模块或即时重写已经提供了答案,有效地将生成器降为单纯的渲染器时,它们才会成功,而后训练几乎没有解决这个限制. 为了测试这种失败是来自像素本身,还是来自目前的训练范式,我们从零开始训练一个纯粹像素空间基因模型的家族,没有任何文字路径。 这些模型以图像作为唯一的输入和输出,读取问题,写出中间步骤,并在画布上直接产生答案. 值得注意的是,它们展现出大型语言模型的标志性行为. 随着权力法的制定,业绩可以预期地得到改善。 通过框架写出中间步骤框架大大超过单框架的回答,与思维链相呼应,而强化学习后培训则会进一步加强推理. 此外,共用一张画布可以让同样的模型在各种模式之间进行推理,而这种能力是只使用文字的语言模型所缺乏的。 据我们所知,这是在纯像素-空间基因模型中对这些现象的首次系统研究,没有文字符号。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1: Unifying modalities and reasoning in pixel space. (a) In our envisioned unified paradigm, text, images, audio, touch, and actions share one canvas, where a pixel-only model reads the current state, generates the next canvas, and feeds it back as input. (b) Current generators rely on text tokens. Such a generator typically writes the answer only when explicitly supplied with it, as shown by real outputs from Qwen-Image-2.1. (c) Trained from scratch without text tokens, our pixel model reasons across modalities frame by frame. Real rollouts from a 33M model on unseen problems interleave arithmetic, dot counting, and region painting, or curve tracing and summation.
blocks.zh: 图 1:在像素空间中统一模式和推理. (a) 在我们设想的统一范式中,文本、图像、音频、触摸和行动共享一个画布,一个只显示像素的模型读取当前状态,生成下一个画布,并将其反馈作为输入。 (b) 现有发电机依赖文本符号。 如Quen-Image-2.1的实际产出所示,这种生成器通常只有在明确提供时才写出答案。 (c) 在无文字标志的情况下从头开始训练,这是我们按框架跨模式框架的像素模型理由。 从33M模型中真正推出的关于未见问题的图解 算术、点数和区域绘画 或曲线追踪和归纳

blocks.en: Almost everything a machine needs to perceive or produce can be drawn. Text is a rendered string, an image is already a canvas, audio becomes a spectrogram, touch a pressure map, and a robot action a trajectory plotted in the workspace. If a single model could read and write all of these on one canvas, the boundaries between modalities would disappear, requiring no per-modality tokenizer, no cross-encoder adapter, and no separate decoder for each output type. A math problem and its solution, a chart and the numbers extracted from it, or a map and a route traced over it would all live in the same image, allowing the model to solve problems by updating that image step by step. This suggests an ambitious goal: unifying all modalities within vision ( Figure 1 a).
blocks.zh: 几乎可以画出机器需要察觉或生产的一切。 文本是一个渲染的字符串,一个图像已经是一个画布,音频变成了一个光谱图,触摸一个压力图,机器人动作是一个在工作空间中绘制的轨迹. 如果一个单一的模型可以在一个画布上读写所有这些,模式之间的界限就会消失,不需要每个模式的标致器,没有跨编码器的适配器,没有针对每个输出类型的单独的解码器. 一个数学问题及其解决方案,一个图表和从中提取的数字,或者一个地图和它上溯到的路线,都会生活在同一个图像中,使模型能够通过一步步更新这个图像来解决问题. 这表明一项雄心勃勃的目标:在愿景内统一所有模式(图1a)。

blocks.en: Language is the natural first test of this goal, and the hardest one. Most symbolic reasoning, such as arithmetic, logic, and recalling or combining facts, takes place in language, which also serves as the reasoning medium for large language models (LLMs). For vision to subsume language, rendering visually plausible text is not enough. A visual model must reason directly over text on the canvas by reading a question written in pixels, solving it, and writing the answer back in pixels. Recent generators make this appear within reach. They render long passages of legible text ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) , follow detailed editing instructions ( Brooks et al., 2023 ; Labs et al., 2025 ) , and unify understanding and generation within a single network ( Deng et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Team, 2025 ) , while video models have even been described as zero-shot reasoners ( Wiedemer et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 语言是这个目标的自然第一测试,也是最难的. 大多数象征性的推理,如算术,逻辑,以及回顾或结合事实,都是用语言进行的,语言也作为大语言模型(LLM)的推理媒介. 要将视觉包含在语言中,使视觉上看似可信的文本是不够的。 一个视觉模型必须通过读取一个用像素写成的问题,解决它,并将答案用像素写回,从而在画布上的文字上直接解释. 最近的发电机使这看起来可以实现。 它们提供了可读文本的长段落(Chen等人,2023年;Yang等人,2023年;Wu等人,2025年),遵循详细的编辑指示(Brooks等人,2023年;Labs等人,2025年),并在单一网络内统一理解和生成(Deng等人,2025年;Zhou等人,2025年)。 2024; 谢等人, 2025; 陈等人, 2025; Team, 2025), 而视频模型甚至被描述为零镜头的推理器. (Wiedemer等人,2025年).

blocks.en: However, we find that the generation modules of these systems cannot reason over text on the canvas. We construct a benchmark where questions appear in pixels and models write answers on the same canvas. Across image, video, and unified multimodal models, pixel-only questions, from word-level to arithmetic and factual tasks, are almost never answered correctly. Each of these models can be separated into a text module and a generation module, and image and video models are often preceded by an auxiliary prompt rewriter that reads the instruction and image to produce a detailed prompt for the text module. Our ablations show that these rewriters and text modules can usually solve the questions themselves, whereas generators succeed only when the rewriter or text module has already supplied the answer in text tokens ( Figure 1 b). Post-training teaches generation modules to copy and rearrange visible characters, yet arithmetic and factual accuracy remains near zero even on training items. Reasoning thus occurs in text tokens, and the visual generator merely renders the outcome of the prompt rewriter or text module. This echoes a common view that visual generators possess little intelligence and act largely as renderers for language models ( Guo et al., 2026 ; Kou et al., 2026 ; Ren et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 然而,我们发现这些系统的生成模块不能在画布上对文本提出理由。 我们构建一个基准,将问题出现在像素中,模型在同一画布上写出答案。 整个图像,视频,以及统一的多式联运模型,像素唯一的问题,从字级到算术和事实任务,几乎从来没有正确回答. 这些模型中每一个都可以分离成文本模块和一代模块,图像和视频模型之前往往有一个辅助的即时重写器,读取指令和图像,为文本模块产生详细的即时. 我们的缩写显示,这些重写和文本模块通常能够自行解决问题,而生成器只有在重写或文本模块已经以文本符号提供答案时才会成功(图1b). 培训后教生成模块复制和重排可见字符,但即使在培训项目上,算术和事实准确度仍然接近零。 因此,在文本符号中出现理由,视觉生成器只是使即时重写或文本模块的结果. 这呼应了一种共同的看法,即视觉生成器缺乏智能,主要充当语言模型的渲染器(Guo等人,2026年;Kou等人,2026年;Ren等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Is this a limitation of pixels themselves, or of how existing models are trained? Current generators are trained to render content described in a text prompt, rather than to reason over text embedded in their visual input ( Betker et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Kou et al., 2026 ) . To disentangle these two factors, we train a family of purely pixel-space generative models from scratch without any text pathway. Implemented as flow-matching transformers operating directly on raw pixels ( Li and He, 2026 ; Lipman et al., 2023 ; Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) , these models have no text tokens, no tokenizer, and no text encoder, so they take only pixels as input and produce only pixels as output. Every task is posed visually on a canvas. The question is printed on the canvas, the model writes its final answer on the same canvas, and when reasoning step by step, it generates a sequence of frames that progressively record intermediate steps onto the canvas ( Figure 1 c). We train models ranging from 7.6M to 458M parameters on arithmetic, multi-digit multiplication, word problems, factual question answering, and cross-modal tasks mixing text and pictures, and evaluate them on held-out problems never seen during training.
blocks.zh: 这是对像素本身的限制,还是对现有模型的培训方式的限制? 目前的发电机经过培训,可以使文字迅速描述的内容,而不是使其视觉输入中包含的文字具有理性(Betker等人,2023年;Chen等人,2023年;Wu等人,2025年;Kou等人,2026年)。 为了解开这两个因素,我们从零开始训练一个纯粹像素空间基因模型的家族,没有任何文字路径。 作为直接在原始像素上运行的流量匹配变压器(Li and He, 2026; Lipman et al, 2023; Peebles and Xie, 2023)执行,这些型号没有文本代号,没有代号器,也没有文本编码器,因此它们只使用像素作为输入,只生产像素作为输出. 每个任务都放在画布上。 问题印在画布上,模型在同一画布上写下最后的答案,当推理一步一步地产生一系列框架,逐渐将中间步骤记录在画布上(图1c). 我们在算术、数位乘法、文字问题、事实问题回答以及混合文本和图片的跨模式任务方面,对7.6M至458M的参数进行培训,并对培训期间从未见过的搁置问题进行评估。

blocks.en: If pixels were the obstacle, these models would fail as well. They do not. Trained from scratch in this purely visual setting, they learn to read, reason, and write directly on the canvas, exhibiting three hallmark behaviors of LLMs, namely scaling laws, chain of thought, and effective reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training.
blocks.zh: 如果像素是障碍,这些模型也会失败. 他们没有。 他们从头开始在这种纯粹的视觉环境中接受训练,学会在画布上直接阅读、解释和写作,展现了LLM的三种标志性行为,即放大定律、思维链以及有效的强化学习(RL)后培训。

blocks.en: Scaling laws. Like LLMs ( Hoffmann et al., 2022 ; Kaplan et al., 2020 ) , our pixel models improve predictably with scale. Crucially, this law extrapolates accurately. On text tasks, the per-step error falls from 0.174 at 7.6M parameters to 0.037 at 458M along a power law, and the law fitted only up to 130M predicts the held-out 458M error within 2%.
blocks.zh: 扩大法律。 和LLMS(Hoffmann等人,2022年;Kaplan等人,2020年)一样,我们的像素模型随着尺度的扩大可以预测得到改进。 关键是,这一定律准确推断. 在文本任务方面,每步误差从0.174 at 7.6M 参数下降到 0.037 at 458M 沿着动力法,而装配到最多130M 的定律预言在 2% 内被搁置 458M 的误差.

blocks.en: Chain of thought. Writing intermediate steps frame by frame substantially outperforms single-frame direct answering, mirroring chain-of-thought reasoning in LLMs ( Wei et al., 2022b ) . At 130M with equal training, frame-by-frame reasoning solves 98.1% of Compute Then Paint and 49.2% of Trace Then Sum problems against 29.2% and 17.0% for direct answering, which reaches only 31.1% and 17.2% even when trained four times longer. On Word Problems, this advantage emerges with scale as accuracy climbs from 3.7% at 7.6M to 78.6% at 130M, while direct answering stays near 1%, resembling the emergent abilities of LLMs ( Wei et al., 2022a ) .
blocks.zh: 思想链. 通过帧写出中间步骤框架,大大超过单帧直接回答,在LLMs中反射思维链推理(Wei等人,2022b ). 在经过同等培训的130M中,逐帧推理解决了98.1%的计算然后涂料和49.2%的跟踪然后Sum问题,而直接回答则分别是29.2%和17.0%,即使受训时间长了4倍,也只有31.1%和17.2%。 在Word Problems上,这种优势随着精度从7.6M的3.7%上升到130M的78.6%,而直接回答则停留在1%左右,类似于LLMs的新兴能力(Wei等人,2022a).

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning. RL post-training with verifiable rewards further strengthens visual reasoning ( Ouyang and others, 2022 ; Shao et al., 2024 ) . Learning from its own rollouts, the model discovers better reasoning trajectories. On Word Problems at 130M, GRPO raises accuracy from 23.7% to 84.6%, whereas supervised fine-tuning with the same compute reaches at most 39.0%.
blocks.zh: 强化学习. 具有可核查奖励的RL后训练进一步加强了视觉推理(欧阳等人,2022年;肖等人,2024年). 从其自身的推出中学习,模型发现了更好的推理轨迹. 关于130M的文字问题,GRPO将精确度从23.7%提高到84.6%,而经过监督的同样计算微调则达到最多39.0%。

blocks.en: Beyond reproducing LLM-like behaviors, this pixel-only paradigm offers a capability that text-only LLMs inherently lack. Because questions, intermediate steps, and answers share a single canvas, one model can reason seamlessly across modalities. In Count Then Paint , the model counts dots inside irregular regions, records the counts and target label in text, and paints the region with the most dots. In Trace Then Sum , it traces intersecting curves and sums the values along them, and in Sum Mazes , it draws a shortest path through a maze while tallying the numbers encountered along the route. All three LLM-like behaviors, including scaling, chain of thought, and RL gains, continue to hold on these cross-modal tasks.
blocks.zh: 除了复制类似LLM的行为外,这个只像素的范式还提供了一种仅文本的LLMs本身缺乏的能力. 因为问题,中间步骤,和答案共用一个画布,所以一个模型可以无缝地在各种模式之间提出理由. 在Counter Then Paint 中,模型在不规则区域内计数点,在文本中记录计数点和目标标签,并用最多点的涂色区域. 在Tracher Then Sum中,它追踪交叉曲线,并汇总沿途的数值,在Sum Mazes中,它绘制一条穿过迷宫的最短路径,同时计算沿途遇到的数字。 所有三种类似LLM的行为,包括缩放,思维链和RL增益,都继续坚持着这些跨模式的任务.

blocks.en: Taken together, these findings demonstrate that the failure of current visual generators on direct textual and cross-modal reasoning stems not from pixels, but from training paradigms. In a purely visual world, a generative model can learn to read, compute, and write directly in pixels, and it exhibits the same foundational dynamics observed in LLMs, namely predictable scaling, gains from step-by-step intermediate computation, and substantial improvements under RL. Vision is therefore a credible substrate for unifying language with other modalities. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first systematic study of these phenomena in purely pixel-space generative models free of text tokens.
blocks.zh: 总之,这些调查结果表明,当前视觉生成器在直接文字和跨模式推理上的失败并非源于像素,而是源于训练范式. 在一个纯粹的视觉世界中,基因模型可以学习直接用像素读取,计算和写作,它表现出LLMs观察到的相同的基础动力学,即可预见缩放,从一步一步的中间计算中获得收益,以及RL下的实质性改进. 因此,远景是与其他方式统一语言的可靠基础。 就我们所知,这是在纯像素-空间基因模型中对这些现象的首次系统研究,没有文字符号。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Textual reasoning in visual generators. Image editing and video models now render legible text ( Labs et al., 2025 ; Wan et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) and follow detailed instructions ( Labs et al., 2025 ; Brooks et al., 2023 ) , yet benchmarks for reasoning-informed generation ( Niu et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) reveal that they struggle on knowledge and reasoning. A common remedy places an LLM prompt rewriter before the visual generator ( Fang et al., 2025 ; Kou et al., 2026 ; Ren et al., 2026 ) , leaving reasoning in text tokens. Other works process text as rendered images. PIXEL ( Rust et al., 2023 ) and CLIPPO ( Tschannen et al., 2023 ) learn language understanding from pixels, while DeepSeek-OCR ( Wei et al., 2025 ) compresses text contexts into vision tokens. Closest to us, PIXAR ( Tai et al., 2024 ) and PixelGPT ( Chai et al., 2024 ) predict rendered text autoregressively as image patches. Trained at small scale on rendered corpora, they remain language models that output only text, using pixels merely as an input or output format. In our work, pixels are the medium of reasoning itself. A single model generates the question, intermediate steps, and answer across modalities on one canvas, allowing us to diagnose current generators and study scaling laws, chain of thought, reinforcement learning, and cross-modal reasoning.
blocks.zh: 视觉生成器中的文字推理. 图像编辑和视频模型现在可以识别文本(Labs等人,2025年;Wan等人,2025年;Wu等人,2025年),并遵循详细的指令(Labs等人,2025年;Brooks等人,2023年),然而推理知情生成的基准(Niu等人,2026年;Sun等人,2026年;Wu等人,2026年;Zhao等人,2026年)却表明他们在知识和推理上挣扎. 常见的补救办法是将LLM即时重写器放在视觉生成器面前(Fang等人,2025年;Kou等人,2026年;Ren等人,2026年),留下文字符号的推理. 其他工作处理文本作为渲染的图像 。 PIXEL(Rust等人,2023年)和CLIPPO(Tschannn等人,2023年)从像素中学习语言理解,而DeepSeek-OCR(Wei等人,2025年)则将文本上下文压缩成视觉符号. 最贴近我们的PIXAR(Tai et al.,2024)和PixelGPT(Chai et al.,2024)预测成像补丁的文本自动递减. 在制成的corpora上进行小规模的训练,它们仍然是只输出文本的语言模型,只使用像素作为输入或输出格式. 在我们的作品中,像素是推理本身的媒介. 一个单一的模型产生一个问题,中间步骤,并在一个画布上跨模式解答,使我们能够诊断目前的发电机并研究缩放定律,思维链,强化学习,以及跨模式推理.

blocks.en: Pixel reasoning in visual generators. Video generators exhibit chain-of-frames reasoning, solving mazes and visual puzzles zero-shot across frames ( Wiedemer et al., 2025 ) , while Sora-2 has been prompted to solve math problems with a prompt rewriter ( Tong et al., 2026 ) . However, a systematic evaluation of Veo-3 over 12 spatial, geometric, physical, temporal, and embodied dimensions shows that while such models handle short-horizon spatial coherence and local dynamics, they fail on long-horizon causal reasoning, strict geometry, and abstract logic, acting more as visual renderers paired with text models ( Guo et al., 2026 ) . Other approaches call visual generators to draw intermediate sketches ( Hu et al., 2024 ) or images ( Li et al., 2025 ) that assist multimodal LLMs. Because these studies evaluate pretrained video models zero-shot or use generated images merely as aids for a text model, the observed reasoning is either shallow or still resides in a text model. In contrast, we train pixel models from scratch with no text pathway. Every reasoning step is written directly in pixels by the generator itself, spanning expressions, word problems, factual questions, and summing values read from curves and mazes.
blocks.zh: 视觉生成器中的像素推理. 视频生成器展现了框架链推理,解决迷宫和视觉谜题的零镜头横跨帧(Wiedemer等人,2025年),而Sora-2则被激励通过即时重写解决数学问题(Tong等人,2026年). 然而,对Veo-3超过12个空间,几何,物理,时间,以及包含的维度的系统评价表明,虽然这些模型处理短视空间一致性和局部动态,但它们在长视因果推理,严格几何,抽象逻辑上都失败了,更能作为视觉渲染器与文本模型配对(Guo等人,2026年). 其他方法称视觉生成器绘制中间草图(Hu等人,2024年)或图像(Li等人,2025年),协助多式联运有限责任公司。 因为这些研究评价了经过预先训练的视频模型零拍或仅作为文本模型的辅助工具而生成的图像,所观察到的推理要么很浅,要么仍然停留在文本模型中. 相反,我们从零开始训练像素模型,没有文字路径。 每个推理步骤都是由生成器本身直接用像素写成的,横跨表达式,词问题,事实问题,以及从曲线和迷宫读取的映射值.

blocks.en: Unified multimodal models. Unified multimodal models perform understanding and generation in one network, either using a single transformer over text and image tokens ( Team, 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2025 ) or employing separate encoders or experts for understanding and generation ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2025 ) . Many such systems can think in text tokens before generating an image, and this thinking step drives their gains on questions requiring knowledge or reasoning ( Deng et al., 2025 ) . Our evaluation shows that the generation pathway of the unified models we test does not itself reason correctly over text on the canvas, since the generation module succeeds almost only when the text-token thoughts already contain the answer. Crucially, these architectures unify modalities in token space, where text remains a sequence of text tokens, images become tokens or latents in the same sequence or network, and reasoning happens in text tokens. We instead unify modalities in visual space itself. Text appears as pixels on the canvas, and a single pixel model without any text tokens reads, reasons, and writes across modalities on one shared canvas.
blocks.zh: 统一的多式联运模式。 统一的多式联运模型在一个网络中进行理解和生成,或者使用单变压器而不是文本和图像符号(Team, 2025;Zhou等人, 2024;Xie等人, 2025),或者使用单独的编码器或专家进行理解和生成(Chen等人, 2025;Deng等人, 2025)。 许多这类系统在生成图像之前可以先用文字符号思考,而这一思考步骤推动了它们在需要知识或推理的问题上的收获(Deng等人,2025年). 我们的评估表明,我们测试的统一模型的生成路径本身不能正确解释画布上的文本,因为生成模块几乎只有在文本脚本的想法已经包含答案时才会成功。 关键是,这些架构统一了符号空间中的模式,其中文本仍然是文本符号的序列,图像成为同序列或网络中的符号或潜伏,推理发生在文本符号中. 相反,我们统一了视觉空间本身的模式。 文本作为像素出现在画布上,一个没有文本符号的单一像素模型在一个共享画布上读取,解释,并跨模式书写.

blocks.en: 3 Evaluating the Textual Reasoning of Current Generators
blocks.zh: 3个 评价当前发电机的文字理由

blocks.en: We first examine whether existing visual generators can reason over text written on the canvas and, when they appear to succeed, where the reasoning actually takes place.
blocks.zh: 我们首先审查现有的视觉生成器是否能够通过画布上写的文字来解释,以及当它们看起来成功时,推理的实际发生地点。

blocks.en: 3.1 Benchmark Design
blocks.zh: 3.1 基准设计

blocks.en: Each item is a 1024 × \times 1024 canvas containing a title, a printed question, a scene of colored shapes for the Visual task, and an empty answer box ( Figure 2 ). In the default condition, the model receives only the canvas alongside a fixed text instruction that is identical across all items, namely “Complete the task shown on the card. Keep everything else on the card unchanged”. Its text module may use its own tokenizer and text encoder to process this instruction. Six tasks span decreasing degrees of answer visibility on the canvas, meaning how much of the correct answer already appears in the question itself, as shown in Figure 2 . Specifically, the benchmark comprises Copy (copying a string, 200 test items), Instruction (applying an instruction to a word, 216), Context (selecting a word from a short passage, 300), Visual (answering a question about a scene, 400), Arithmetic (300), and Factual (answering a factual question, 579). We employ Qwen3.8-Max, a strong multimodal model, as the judge to determine whether the output of a generator is correct.
blocks.zh: 每个项目是1024 ×\times 1024画布,包含标题,打印问题,视觉任务彩色形状的场景,以及空答框(图2). 在默认条件下,该模型只接收一个与所有项目相同的固定文本指令,即“完成卡片上显示的任务”。 保持卡片上的其他一切不变”。 它的文本模块可能使用它自己的指示器和文本编码器来处理这个指令. 如图2所示,6项任务涉及在画布上的答题可见度下降,这意味着问题本身中已经出现多少正确答案。 具体来说,基准包括复制(复制一个字符串,200个测试项目)、指令(将一个指令应用到一个单词,216)、上下文(从一个短段落中选择一个单词,300)、视觉(回答关于一个场景的问题,400)、Arithmetic(300)和事实(回答一个事实问题,579)。 我们使用一个强大的多式联运模型Quen3.8-Max作为判断器,以确定一个生成器的输出是否正确.

blocks.en: Figure 2: The six tasks of the benchmark. Ordered by decreasing answer visibility from string copying to factual recall, each task tests whether a generator can read a question on the canvas and write the answer into the empty box.
blocks.zh: 图 2:基准的六项任务。 通过降低从字符串复制到事实召回的答案可见度来排序,每个任务测试一个生成器是否能够在画布上读出一个问题,并将答案写入空框.

blocks.en: Four diagnostic conditions control whether and in what form the generation module sees the answer. For image editing and video models, Rewrite passes the instruction and image through a prompt rewriter that produces a detailed prompt often containing the answer, and Delete removes the answer from that rewritten prompt. For unified multimodal models, Render writes the answer into the prompt as text tokens, such as instructing the model to write “Madrid”, the capital of Spain, in the answer box, and Think lets the text module reason in text tokens before the image is generated. Appendix A gives the details.
blocks.zh: 四个诊断条件可以控制生成模块是否以及以何种形式看到答案. 对于图像编辑和视频模型,Rewrite通过一个即时的重写器传递指令和图像,该重写器产生一个往往包含答案的详细的快速,并删除该重写提示中的答案. 对于统一的多式联运模型,Render将答案写到提示器中作为文本符号,比如指示模型在答案框中写"马德里"(Madrid),在图像生成之前让文本模块在文本符号中说明理由. 附 录 A给出细节。

blocks.en: 3.2 Results on Current Generators
blocks.zh: 3.2 关于现有发电机的结果

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , current visual generators answer almost nothing in the default condition. Open image editing models, including FLUX.3-klein, Qwen-Image-2.1, and LongCat-Image-Edit, score 0% on every task, even on Copy where the answer is already visible in the question. Video generation models fail in the same way, leaving the answer box empty in most generated frames and often answering no item at all. Unified multimodal models likewise answer almost nothing when generating directly, with BAGEL, InternVL-U, and Emu3.5 scoring 0% and SenseNova reaching only 0% to 5% outside the Copy task. By contrast, closed systems such as GPT-Image-2.5, Gemini-3-Pro-Image, and Nano-Banana-2.1 answer most items, with averages of 98.0%, 94.1%, and 92.0%. However, our experiments in Table 1 and Appendix B , together with public analyses of these systems, indicate that their success relies essentially on an external or built-in text reasoning step. OpenAI documents that in its image generation tool the LLM revises the prompt before image generation ( OpenAI, ) , Gemini image models always think in text tokens before drawing ( Google, ) , and a diagnostic study of GPT-4o image generation points to a language model followed by an image decoder ( Yan et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,目前的视觉发电机在默认条件下几乎不回答任何问题。 开放图像编辑模型,包括FLUX.3-klein,Quen-Image-2.1和LongCat-Image-Edit,在每个任务上得分为0%,甚至在问题中已经可见答案的Copy上. 视频生成模型以同样的方式失败,在大多数生成的帧中留下了答案框的空位,并且经常不回答任何项目. 统一的多式联运模式在直接生成时几乎一无所获,BAGEL、InternVL-U和Emu3.5得分为0%,SenseNova在复制任务之外只达到0%至5%。 相比之下,GPT-Image-2.5,双子座-3-Pro-Image,Nano-Banana-2.1等封闭系统则回答了大多数项目,平均回答率为98.0%,94.1%,92.0%. 然而,我们在表1和附录B中的试验以及对这些系统的公开分析表明,这些系统的成功主要取决于外部或内在文本推理步骤。 OpenAI的文档显示,LLM在其图像生成工具中修改了图像生成前的提示(OpenAI,),双子座图像模型在绘图前总是在文本符中思考(Google,),对GPT-4o图像生成的诊断研究指向一个语言模型,然后是图像解码器(Yan等人,2025年).

blocks.en: Table 1: Exact accuracy in percent of current visual generators. In Default , models receive only the canvas and a fixed prompt without the answer. For image and video models, Rewrite uses a prompt rewriter that often supplies the answer, and Delete removes the answer from the rewritten prompt. For unified models, Render writes the answer into the prompt as text tokens, and Think turns on thinking mode, enabling text-token reasoning before generation. Video models are judged on the final frame. Dashes mark inapplicable or unavailable conditions, as closed systems whose prompt rewriter cannot be disabled lack Default, and systems whose internal rewritten prompt cannot be edited lack Delete. The highest value per row is in bold.
blocks.zh: 表1:当前视觉发电机的精确准确率。 在默认情况下,模型只接收画布和没有答案的固定提示. 对于图像和视频模型,Rewrite使用一个经常提供答案的即时重写,删除从重写即时删除答案. 对于统一的模型,Render将答案写到提示中作为文本符号,而Think则开启思维模式,在生成前便允许文本脚本推理. 视频模型在最终框架上进行判断. Dashes 标记不适用或无法使用的条件,因为无法禁用快速重写功能的关闭系统缺乏默认,而无法编辑内部重写提示的系统缺乏删除功能。 每行最高值为粗体.

blocks.en: 3.3 Where the Reasoning Happens
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 原因发生的地方

blocks.en: Figure 3: Test-set accuracy after post-training the generation module of four image editing models. All base models start at 0% on every task. Post-training teaches the generators to copy visible strings, yet accuracy falls steeply as answer visibility in the question decreases and stays at 0% to 2% on Arithmetic and Factual.
blocks.zh: 图3:训练后测试的精度,四个图像编辑模型的生成模块. 所有基础模型在每次任务上以0%开始. 训练后教导发电机复制可见的字符串,然而准确性却随着问题中的答案可见度的降低而急剧下降,并在Aristemic和Factic上保持在0%至2%.

blocks.en: We find that the only path to a correct answer on the canvas is for that answer to be first produced as text tokens by the prompt rewriter of an image editing or video model, or by the text module of a unified multimodal model. As shown in Table 1 , after a rewriter expands the prompt, image editing and video models draw the answer correctly in most cases because the rewritten prompt often contains the answer. For example, Qwen-Image-2.1 reaches 86.0% with a rewriter, and MiniMax-H3 reaches 98.3%. Yet when only the answer is deleted from the rewritten prompt while everything else is kept, the success rate of every tested generator drops to near 0%. The rewriter thus helps by directly supplying the answer to the generation module.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,在画布上找到正确答案的唯一途径是,首先通过迅速重写图像编辑或视频模型或统一多式联运模型的文本模块,将答案作为文本符号制作出来。 如表1所示,在重写扩展了即时,图像编辑和视频模型在多数情况下都正确绘制答案,因为重写即时往往包含答案. 例如,Quen-Image-2.1通过重写达到86.0%,MiniMax-H3达到98.3%. 然而,当只删除重写提示中的答案而保留其他所有内容时,每个测试的生成器的成功率下降到接近0%。 因此,重写器通过直接为生成模块提供答案而有所帮助.

blocks.en: The text modules themselves possess the reasoning capability. Used as chat models, the text encoders of FLUX.2-klein, FLUX.3-klein, Qwen-Image-2.1, and LongCat-Image-Edit answer 86% to 97% of Factual items and 83% to 100% of Arithmetic items in text tokens. When the conditioning states passed from the text encoder to the generator in Qwen-Image-2.1 are decoded with the encoder’s own language-model head, the first token of the correct answer ranks among the top 10 for 140 of 150 Factual questions, yet the generator writes none of these answers, as detailed in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 文本模块本身具有推理能力. 用作聊天模式的FLUX.2-klein,FLUX.3-klein,Quen-Image-2.1和LongCat-Image-Edit的文本编码器在文本符中解答了86%至97%的事实项目和83%至100%的Arithmetic项目. 当调制状态从文本编码器传到Quen-Image-2.1的生成器时,用编码器自己的语言模型头来解码,正确答案的第一个标志在150个事实问题的140个中排在前十位,然而生成器却没有写这些答案,详见附录D.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Overview of the ten pixel-space reasoning tasks. Each 192 × \times 192 (256 × \times 256 for Word Problems) canvas places the question and correct intermediate reasoning steps above a horizontal rule, with the final answer written below.
blocks.zh: 图4:十项像素空间推理任务概述. 每192 ×\times 192 (256 ×\times for Word Problems) 画布将问题和正确的中间推理步骤置于一个水平规则之上,最后的答案如下.

blocks.en: Unified multimodal models likewise reason only in text tokens. SenseNova, which thinks in text tokens before generating, answers 96.0% of items in thinking mode ( Table 1 ). Reading its thoughts item by item reveals that the generated image is correct on 99.0% of the items whose thought contains the answer, compared to only 10% whose thought does not. InternVL-U follows the same pattern, as Appendix D shows.
blocks.zh: 同样,统一多式联运模式也只在文字符号中说明理由。 SenseNova,它在生成前在文本符中思考,在思维模式(表1)中回答96.0%的项目. 逐项阅读其思想项目显示,在思想包含答案的99.0%的项目上生成的图像是正确的,而只有10%的思考没有. InternVL-U遵循同样的模式,如附录D所示.

blocks.en: 3.4 Post-Training the Generation Module
blocks.zh: 3.4 培训后一代单元

blocks.en: We next test whether post-training the generation module enables it to reason directly on the canvas. For FLUX.2-klein, FLUX.3-klein, Qwen-Image-2.1, and LongCat-Image-Edit, we train one LoRA per task that maps a canvas with an empty box to the same canvas with the answer written in, as detailed in Appendix C . As shown in Figure 3 , accuracy falls steeply as answer visibility decreases. It reaches 80% to 93% on Copy , where the answer appears in the question, and only 10% to 12% on new words in Instruction , where FLUX.3-klein, at 82%, masters only the five trained rules but scores 0% on an unseen one, as Table 5 in Appendix C shows. It falls further to at most 29% on Context , below 10% on Visual , and 0% to 2% on Arithmetic and Factual . These accuracies hold on training and test sets alike, so the models learn to copy visible text rather than to think or recall.
blocks.zh: 接下来我们测试 训练后 生成模块是否使其 直接在画布上解释。 对于FLUX.2-klein,FLUX.3-klein,Quen-Image-2.1和LongCat-Image-Edit,我们每个任务训练一个LORA,用空盒子将画布映射到同一个画布上,并附上附录C中的答案。 如图3所示,随着答案可见度的降低,准确性急剧下降。 如附录C表5所示,在“指令”中,FLUX.3-Klein以82%的成绩只掌握了五个经过训练的规则,但在一个看不见的规则上得分为0%。 超过29%, 低于10%, 这些敏锐度同样坚持培训和测试,因此模型学会复制可见文本而不是思考或召回.

blocks.en: Fine-tuning the generation module of a unified multimodal model yields the same result. BAGEL’s text module answers 83% of 450 benchmark items in text tokens, yet training its generation module, alone or together with the text module, to write the answer keeps Default accuracy at 0% to 1.8%, while the same training lifts Render from 47% to 60% on these items, as detailed in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 对统一的多式联运模式的生成模块进行精细调整得出同样的结果。 BAGEL的文本模块在文本符号中回答了450个基准项目的83%,然而,单独或与文本模块一起培训其生成模块,以写入答案,默认准确度保持在0至1.8%,而如附录C所详述的,同样的培训将这些项目的Render从47%升至60%。

blocks.en: 3.5 Summary
blocks.zh: 3.5 总结

blocks.en: Across all generation systems whose pipelines we can inspect, nearly every correct answer on the canvas is preceded by the same answer in text tokens. Their generation modules can read the canvas and write text, yet reasoning occurs in the prompt rewriter or text module, and the generators only render the result ( Kou et al., 2026 ; Ren et al., 2026 ) . Whether a pixel generator trained from scratch without any text pathway can learn to reason over text on the canvas is the question we turn to next.
blocks.zh: 几乎所有的正确答案 都用同样的文字符号来表示 他们的生成模块可以读取画布和写出文字,然而推理发生在即时重写或文本模块中,生成器只产生结果(Kou等人,2026年;Ren等人,2026年). 一个从零开始训练的像素生成器, 没有任何文字路径, 是否能够在画布上学习如何解释文字, 是我们接下来要处理的问题 。

blocks.en: 4 Pixel-Space Generative Models without Text Tokens
blocks.zh: 4 无文本键的像素- 空间基因模型

blocks.en: We now remove the text pathway entirely and construct a purely visual world. This section introduces the tasks, model architecture, and training regimes.
blocks.zh: 我们现在完全删除文本路径,构建一个纯粹的视觉世界。 本节介绍任务、示范架构和培训制度。

blocks.en: 4.1 Tasks
blocks.zh: 4.1 任务

blocks.en: Every problem is presented on a square grey canvas. Text is rendered in a fixed monospaced font on a grid of 24 columns and 12 rows of 8 × \times 16-pixel cells. The question occupies the upper rows, a horizontal rule separates it from two answer rows at the bottom, and visual elements such as curves, regions, and dots are drawn in the remaining space. The model never receives character codes, seeing only pixels and writing only pixels. Figure 4 illustrates all ten tasks. Four text tasks, namely Expressions , Multiplication , Word Problems , and Factual Questions , mirror the symbolic reasoning that LLMs perform in text. Six cross-modal tasks, namely Mazes , Sum Mazes , Curve Tracing , Trace Then Sum , Count Then Paint , and Compute Then Paint , interleave text and pictures in both the problem statement and the solution process.
blocks.zh: 每一个问题都放在一个平面灰色的画布上。 文本以固定的单间字体在24列和12列8×\times 16像素单元格的网格上渲染. 问题占据上行,一个水平规则将其从底部的两个答案行中分离出来,在剩余空间中绘制曲线,区域,点等视觉元素. 模型从未收到字符代码,只看到像素,只写像素. 图4说明了所有10项任务。 四个文本任务,即表达、乘法、文字问题和事实问题,反映了LLMs在文本中的象征性推理。 六种跨模式任务,即Mazes、Sum Mazes、Curve Tracking、Race Then Sum、Counter Then paint、以及Compute Then paint,在问题说明和解决方案进程中互换文本和图片。

blocks.en: 4.2 Model and Training
blocks.zh: 4.2 模式和培训

blocks.en: The model is a flow-matching transformer operating directly on pixels ( Lipman et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) , with no VAE, no tokenizer, and no text encoder. Following JiT ( Li and He, 2026 ) , the network predicts the clean image and is trained with the velocity loss. Its input is the channel-wise concatenation of the conditioning canvas (the original problem canvas, or the current canvas in frame-by-frame reasoning) and the noisy target canvas, partitioned into 576 patches of 8 × \times 8 pixels, while the time step enters through adaptive layer normalization. We train five model sizes ranging from 7.6M to 458M parameters under a unified recipe, as detailed in Table 6 of Appendix F .
blocks.zh: 该型号是直接在像素上运行的流配变压器(Lipman等人,2023年;Liu等人,2023年;Peebles和Xie,2023年),没有VAE,没有标注器,也没有文本编码器. 追随JiT(李和贺,2026年),网络预测清真影像,并接受速度损失训练. 它的输入是调制画布(原问题画布,或按帧逐帧推理的当前画布)和吵闹的目标画布的通道-顺理成章,分割为576个补丁8×\time8像素,而时间步则通过适应层正常化进入. 如附录F表6所详述的,我们在一个统一的食谱下训练5个型号大小从7.6M到458M参数不等。

blocks.en: Using the same architecture, data, and training budget, we train the model under two regimes. Direct answering maps the original problem canvas to the final canvas with the answer in a single generation, without any written intermediate steps. Frame-by-frame reasoning trains the model on pairs of consecutive frames, mapping the canvas at step t to the canvas at step t+1. At test time, it generates frames sequentially starting from the original problem canvas, feeding each generated frame directly back in raw pixel space as the input for the next step. The canvas thus serves as the sole memory, so everything the model computes must be recorded on it. Rollout terminates once the model writes an answer into the answer box, allowing the model itself to decide how many frames to draw. In this setup, frame-by-frame reasoning corresponds to chain of thought, whereas direct answering corresponds to answering without intermediate thought. Further training and evaluation details are provided in Appendices F and G .
blocks.zh: 我们利用同样的结构、数据和培训预算,在两种制度下培训模型。 直接回答将原问题画布映射到最后画布上,用一个世代的答案,没有任何书面的中间步骤. 逐帧推理在一对连续帧上对模型进行训练,将画布逐步图t到画布上逐步图t+1. 在测试时,它从原来的问题画布开始依次生成帧,将每个生成的帧直接反馈到原始像素空间中作为下一步的输入. 画布因此成为唯一的内存,所以模型计算的所有内容都必须记录在它上. 一旦模型将一个答案写进解答框中,推出就会终止,让模型本身决定要绘制多少帧. 在这个设定中,逐帧推理对应思想链,而直接回答对应没有中间思想的回答. 附录F和G提供了进一步的培训和评价细节。

blocks.en: 5 Scaling Laws
blocks.zh: 5 扩大法律

blocks.en: LLMs that reason in text tokens improve predictably with parameter count ( Kaplan et al., 2020 ; Hoffmann et al., 2022 ) , as do diffusion transformers that render images in pixel space ( Liang et al., 2026 ) . We examine whether reasoning performed directly in pixels obeys the same scaling law.
blocks.zh: 文本符号中的LLMs这一理由通过参数计数可以预测地得到改善(Kaplan等人,2020年;Hoffmann等人,2022年),在像素空间生成图像的扩散变压器也是如此(Liang等人,2026年)。 我们检查在像素中直接表现的推理是否符合同样的缩放定律.

blocks.en: 5.1 Setup and Metric
blocks.zh: 5.1 设置和计量

blocks.en: Figure 5: Pixel-space reasoning obeys power-law scaling. From 7.6M to 458M parameters, per-step error in generating the next frame falls linearly on log-log scales for two models, one evaluated across Expressions, Multiplication, and Factual Questions and the other on Curve Tracing. Power laws fitted to medians from 7.6M to 130M extrapolate accurately to the held-out 458M model, with dashed lines matching measured medians within 2% and 8%. Across five seeds per size, boxes cover the middle three, whiskers span all five, and black bars mark medians.
blocks.zh: 图5:像素-空间推理遵循权力法缩放. 从7.6M到458M的参数,在生成下一个帧时的每步误差在对数比尺度上线性地落在两个模型上,一个模型在表达式,乘法,和事实问题之间进行评价,另一个模型在曲线追踪上. 功率定律为7.6M到130M的中位数,精确地推导到搁置的458M模型,虚线匹配测量的中位数在2%和8%以内. 每只大小五颗种子 盒子覆盖中间三颗 胡须横跨所有五颗 黑条标记中位数

blocks.en: We train frame-by-frame models at five scales from 7.6M to 458M parameters with one recipe and five seeds per size. We measure the per-step error, the visual analogue of per-token error in an LLM. It is defined as the fraction of next frames generated from a correct canvas that contain a wrong character on text tasks or whose changed pixels have an IoU below 0.8 with the ground-truth update on cross-modal tasks. We train two joint models and fit a power law L ⁡ ( N ) = A ​ N − α L(N)=A\,N^{-\alpha} to each resulting per-step error curve. The first is trained on Expressions with four steps, Multiplication with 4 × \times 4 digits, and Factual Questions and evaluated on their average. The second is trained on Mazes, Curve Tracing, and Count Then Paint, and since Mazes and Count Then Paint saturate from 33M on, it is evaluated on Curve Tracing.
blocks.zh: 我们按五个尺度逐个培训帧模型,从7.6M到458M参数,每个尺寸有一个食谱和五个种子。 我们在 LLM 中测量每步错误,每键错误的视觉模拟. 它被定义为在文本任务上包含错误字符的正确画布产生的下一个框架的一小部分,或者其变化的像素的IoU低于0.8,同时对跨模式任务进行地面真实更新. 我们训练两个联合型号,并安装一个功率定律L →(N) = A N − α L(N) = A\,(N) −(alpha) 每个产生的每步误差曲线。 第一个是用四个步骤进行表达式培训,一个是乘法,乘法为 4× \time 4 位数,另一个是事实问题,并按平均值加以评价。 第二部关于Mazes、Curve Track和Counter Then Paint的培训,自Mazes和Counter Then Paint饱和33M以来,在Curve Track上进行了评估。

blocks.en: 5.2 Power-Law Fit
blocks.zh: 5.2 适合电力法

(a) Writing steps frame by frame outperforms direct answering across all six tasks at equal training of 40k steps and surpasses four times longer direct training on four of them. (b) On the four cross-modal tasks, each run continues from a Start model trained on non-optimal demonstrations with extra steps or detours. Under equal compute, RL outperforms non-optimal SFT and surpasses optimal SFT on four tasks at 33M and all six at 130M. We apply GRPO to the two text tasks and RFT to the four cross-modal tasks. For the four multimodal tasks, test accuracy requires a correct answer in the fewest frames.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 5 , per-step error follows a power law on both curves and extrapolates accurately to a larger model. For each curve, we fit the power law using the median error across the five seeds at each scale from 7.6M to 130M and predict the performance of the held-out 458M model. On the text tasks, the median error falls from 0.174 at 7.6M to 0.064 at 130M, following L(N) ∝ \propto N − - 0.360 , and the measured error of the 458M model lies 2% below the prediction. On Curve Tracing in the joint cross-modal model, the error follows L(N) ∝ \propto N − - 0.340 , with the 458M model measuring 8% above the prediction. blocks.en: 6 Chain of Thought
blocks.zh: 6 思想链

blocks.en: In LLMs, generating intermediate reasoning steps before producing the final answer improves performance ( Nye et al., 2021 ; Wei et al., 2022b ) . Our pixel models can perform the same computation directly on the canvas. Using the same model architecture, training data, and training budget, we compare frame-by-frame reasoning against direct answering.
blocks.zh: 在LLMs中,在生成最终答案之前生成中间推理步骤可以提高性能(Nye等人,2021年;Wei等人,2022年b ). 我们的像素模型可以直接在画布上进行同样的计算. 我们利用同样的模式结构、培训数据以及培训预算,将框架推理与直接回答进行比较。

blocks.en: With an equal training budget of 40k steps, writing intermediate steps frame by frame substantially outperforms direct answering across all six tasks, as shown in Figure 6 a. On Expressions task, frame-by-frame reasoning solves 83.4% and 88.3% of unseen problems at 33M and 130M parameters, compared to 27.1% and 33.2% for direct answering. On Word Problems , frame-by-frame accuracy reaches 47.8% and 78.6%, whereas direct answering remains at 1.1% and 1.2%. Training direct answering four times longer, for 160k steps, barely narrows the gap. At 33M and 130M parameters, frame-by-frame reasoning trained for only 40k steps achieves 29.5% and 49.2% on Trace Then Sum and 61.9% and 98.1% on Compute Then Paint , while direct answering trained for 160k steps reaches only 15.2% and 17.2% on Trace Then Sum and 29.5% and 31.1% on Compute Then Paint . Writing steps frame by frame is thus both far more accurate and much faster to learn.
blocks.zh: 如图6a所示,培训预算为40k级,按框架编写中间步骤框架大大超过所有六项任务的直接答复。 在表达式任务上,逐帧推理在33M参数和130M参数下解决了83.4%和88.3%的隐性问题,而直接回答的比例分别为27.1%和33.2%。 关于文字问题,每帧准确度达到47.8%和78.6%,而直接回答仍为1.1%和1.2%。 训练直接回答4倍长,为160k步,几乎缩小了差距. 在33M和130M的参数中,仅培训40k步的帧推理在跟踪Sum上达到29.5%和49.2%,在计算Sum上达到61.9%和98.1%,而培训160k步的直接回答在跟踪Sum上达到15.2%和17.2%,在计算Sum上达到29.5%和31.1%。 因此,按框架书写步骤框架不仅更准确,而且更快。

blocks.en: Crucially, this advantage emerges with scale. On Word Problems , frame-by-frame accuracy climbs from 3.7% at 7.6M parameters to 47.8% at 33M and 78.6% at 130M, while direct answering stays near 1% across all model sizes. Mirroring chain-of-thought behavior in LLMs ( Wei et al., 2022b ; Wei et al., 2022a ) , generating intermediate steps helps only once the model is large enough to execute each individual step reliably, as detailed in Appendix I .
blocks.zh: 关键是,这种优势随着规模而出现。 在Word Problems上,帧精确度从7.6M参数的3.7%上升到33M参数的47.8%和130M参数的78.6%,而在所有模型大小上,直接回答都保持在接近1%的水平. 模拟LLMs中的思维链行为(Wei等人,2022b;Wei等人,2022a),生成中间步骤只有在模型足够大足以可靠地执行每个单个步骤时才有帮助,详见附录一.

blocks.en: 7 Reinforcement-Learning Post-Training
blocks.zh: 7 强化学习后培训

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves the reasoning of LLMs beyond supervised training ( Ouyang and others, 2022 ; Shao et al., 2024 ; Guo and others, 2025 ) . We investigate whether the same holds for reasoning conducted in pixels.
blocks.zh: 强化学习和可核查的奖励改进了LLMs超出监督培训的推理(Oyang等人,2022年;Shao等人,2024年;Guo等人,2025年)。 我们调查在像素中进行的推理是否同样适用。

blocks.en: 7.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 7.1 实验设置

blocks.en: On the two text tasks in Figure 6 b, we apply GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) to entire multi-frame rollouts and reward an exact answer read from pixels, as detailed in Appendix H . On the four cross-modal tasks, we use rejection-sampling fine-tuning, or RFT, which trains on the model’s own successful rollouts.
blocks.zh: 关于图6b中的两个文本任务,我们采用GRPO(Shao等人,2024年)来进行整个多框架推出,并奖励从像素读取的准确答案,详见附录H。 在四个跨模式的任务中,我们使用拒绝抽样的微调,或者RFT,它通过模型本身的成功推出来进行训练。

blocks.en: To test whether RL discovers better solutions rather than imitating data, we continue from the same supervised start model with RL or with the same compute of supervised fine-tuning on optimal or non-optimal demonstrations, termed optimal SFT and non-optimal SFT. On the cross-modal tasks, the non-optimal demonstrations contain detours. In Sum Mazes , they follow a longer path. In Count Then Paint and Compute Then Paint , half of the demonstrations first box an incorrect region and correct it in the next frame, while in Trace Then Sum , half first trace an unrequested curve. Optimal demonstrations take the fewest frames and no detour. On the text tasks, the non-optimal demonstrations repeat steps, as detailed in Appendix H . The start model is trained on the non-optimal demonstrations for the cross-modal tasks and on optimal ones for the text tasks. Whenever RL outperforms optimal SFT, it shows that the model has found better solutions through its own rollouts.
blocks.zh: 为了检验RL是否发现更好的解决方案,而不是模仿数据,我们继续从同一个有监督的启动模型开始使用RL,或者用同样的计算,对最佳或非最佳演示进行有监督的微调,称为最佳SFT和非最佳SFT. 关于跨模式任务,非理想的示威活动包含绕道。 在Sum Mazes,他们走的路更长。 在 Counter Then Paint and compute then Paint 中,一半的演示首先输入一个不正确的区域并在下一个框中更正,而在 Trace Then Sum中,一半首先跟踪一个未请求的曲线. 最佳的示威用的是最少的架子,没有绕道. 关于文字任务,如附录H所详述,非最佳演示重复步骤。 启动模式对跨模式任务的非最佳示范和文本任务的最佳示范进行了培训。 当RL超越最佳SFT时,它表明该模型通过自己的推出找到了更好的解决方案.

blocks.en: 7.2 Comparison with Supervised Training
blocks.zh: 7.2 与监督培训的比较

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 6 b, RL improves reasoning across all six tasks. Non-optimal SFT yields little gain, whereas RL, learning solely from its own rollouts, matches or outperforms optimal SFT in most settings. At 130M parameters, RL surpasses optimal SFT on every task, reaching 84.6% compared to 39.0% on Word Problems , 43.7% compared to 35.7% on Trace Then Sum , and 73.2% compared to 61.0% on Compute Then Paint . At 33M parameters, RL outperforms optimal SFT on Expressions , Word Problems , Count Then Paint , and Compute Then Paint .
blocks.zh: 如图6b所示,RL改进了所有六项任务的推理。 非最佳 SFT 得益甚微,而 RL 则仅从其自身的推出中学习,匹配或超越大多数情况下的最佳 SFT. 在130M参数下,RL在每项任务上都超过了最佳SFT,在Word Problems上达到84.6%,在39.0%;在Traces Then Sum上达到43.7%,在Traces Then Sum上达到35.7%;在计算Then Paint上达到73.2%,而在计算上达到61.0%。 在33M参数中,RL在表达式,Word Problems,Counter then paint,以及计算后绘画上优于最佳SFT.

blocks.en: Crucially, RL reshapes how the model reasons. On Expressions , it learns to take smaller steps across more frames, trading a longer rollout for fewer per-frame errors, much as RL lengthens reasoning chains in LLMs ( Guo and others, 2025 ) . For example, on this task, the average rollout length grows from 3.34 to 4.53 frames at 33M and from 3.36 to 4.01 frames at 130M, while supervised training remains between 3.3 and 3.4 frames. On the cross-modal tasks, RL learns to eliminate the detours present in its initial demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 关键的是,RL重塑了模型的原因. 在表达方式上,它学会了跨更多框架采取较小的步骤,用更长的推出时间来换取更少的每帧错误,就像RL延长LLMs的推理链(Guo等人,2025年)一样. 例如,在这项工作上,平均推出时间从33M的3.34帧增加到4.53帧,130M的3.36帧增加到4.01帧,而监督训练则保持在3.3至3.4帧之间。 在跨模式任务上,RL学习消除最初的演示中出现的绕道.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We asked whether vision can unify other modalities, starting with symbolic reasoning over text on a canvas. Across current image editing, video generation, and unified multimodal systems, visual generation modules cannot reason on their own and succeed only when an external prompt rewriter or built-in text module already supplies the answer in text tokens, a limitation post-training barely resolves. Purely pixel-space models trained from scratch without any text pathway instead learn to read, reason, and write on the canvas. Their per-step error on held-out problems follows a power law in parameter count. Frame-by-frame reasoning far outperforms direct answering with gains emerging at scale, and RL strengthens reasoning further. Because text and pictures share one canvas, a single model can also reason seamlessly across modalities, a capability text-only LLMs lack. Together, these findings indicate that the failure of current visual generators stems from their training rather than from pixels themselves, and establish vision as a credible substrate for unifying text and other modalities. Scaling this paradigm up is the natural next step.
blocks.zh: 我们问,愿景是否能够统一其他方式,首先是在画布上对案文进行象征性推理。 通过当前图像编辑,视频生成,以及统一的多模式系统,视觉生成模块无法自行解释,只有在外部即时重写或内置的文本模块已经以文本符号提供答案时才能成功,限制后训练几乎无法解决. 纯像素空间模型从零开始训练,没有文字路径,而是学会在画布上阅读、解释和写作。 它们在被搁置问题上的逐步错误遵循参数计数中的权力定律. 逐个框架的推理远远超越了以规模上的新收益直接回应的效果,RL进一步加强了推理. 由于文本和图片共享一个画布,一个单一的模型也可以无缝地说明跨模式的理由,一种能力唯文本的LLMs缺乏. 这些调查结果表明,当前视觉发电机的故障源于其训练,而不是像素本身,并将愿景确立为统一文本和其他模式的可信基础。 扩大这一范式是下一个自然步骤。

blocks.en: Appendix A The benchmark of Section 3
blocks.zh: 附录A 第3节的基准

blocks.en: Canvases. Each item is a 1024 × \times 1024 canvas with a printed title, a printed question, and an empty answer box under the label “Write the answer here:”. Every model receives the canvas and the default instruction “Complete the task shown on the card. Keep everything else on the card unchanged.”, identical for every item. Video generation models receive the canvas as their first frame.
blocks.zh: 坎盘. 每件物品都是一张1024 ×\times 1024画布,上面有印刷标题,印刷问题,并在“在此写答案:”的标签下有一个空答框。 每个模型都收到画布和默认指令“完成卡上显示的任务。 牌上其他一切不变,每件都一样。 视频生成模型作为第一帧接收画布.

blocks.en: Tasks and test sets. 25% of the source material of each task is held out for testing. Copy asks for a random string over a 32-character alphabet to be copied, and is tested on new strings. Instruction applies a rule to a word, such as writing it backwards, giving its first or last letter, writing it in upper case, or writing it twice. One test set applies trained rules to new words, and another applies a rule never trained, writing the word without its first letter. Context selects a word from a short passage and is tested on trained passage types with new names. Visual answers a question about a scene of colored shapes and is tested on new scenes. Arithmetic evaluates a short expression and is tested on new expressions. Factual asks questions over six relations, namely capital, continent, language, chemical symbol, author, and antonym, and is tested on paraphrases of trained facts, reversed questions, two-hop questions, and untrained facts.
blocks.zh: 任务和测试集。 25%的每项任务的源材料都用于测试。 Copy要求将32个字符表上的随机字符串进行复制,并在新字符串上进行测试. 指令将规则应用于一个单词,如向后写,给予其第一或最后一封信,在上案中写,或写两次. 一个测试集对新词应用经过训练的规则,另一个应用一个从未受过训练的规则,在没有第一个字母的情况下写字. 上下文从短段落中选择一个单词,并用新名字在训练过的通道类型上进行测试. Visual回答一个关于彩色形状的场景的问题,并在新场景中测试. 算术评价一个短表达式,在新表达式上进行测试. 事实在6个关系上提出问题,即首都,大陆,语言,化学符号,作者,以及Antonym, 并且通过对训练有素的事实的诠释,倒置问题,双跳问题,以及未经训练的事实来测试.

blocks.en: Judge. Qwen3.8-Max transcribes the text inside the answer box, in whatever style it is written, without seeing the question or the answer key. An item is correct when the transcription matches the answer exactly after normalizing whitespace, and also case where the task ignores case. For videos, the judge reads 8 evenly spaced frames, and we report the final frame and whether any frame is correct.
blocks.zh: 法官们 Quen3.8-Max在答题框内翻写文字,无论写作什么风格,都不见问答键. 当笔录完全在白空间正常化后与答案匹配时,以及当任务忽略大小写时,一个项目是正确的。 对于视频,法官读取8个均匀间隔的帧,我们报告最终帧,以及任何帧是否正确.

blocks.en: Conditions. Beyond Default, four conditions control whether and in what form the generation module sees the answer. Rewrite expands the instruction and the input image into a more detailed, structured, and constraining prompt before the text module encodes it. Delete removes any answer from that rewritten prompt. Render writes the answer into the prompt as text tokens, for example asking the model to write “Madrid”, the capital of Spain, in the answer box. Think lets the text module of a unified model first reason about the canvas in text tokens and then generate the image from that reasoning.
blocks.zh: 条件 除了默认,四个条件控制生成模块是否以及以什么形式看到答案. 重写将指令和输入图像扩展为更详细,结构化,在文本模块编码之前约束的提示. 删除重写提示中的任何答案 。 Render将答案写到提示中,作为文本符号,例如请模型在回答框中写上西班牙首都“马德里”。 思考让一个统一的模型的文本模块首先在文本符中解释画布的原因,然后从这个推理中生成图像.

blocks.en: Rewrites. The image editing models use their official prompt upsamplers or rewriting rules. For Delete , Qwen3.8-Max deletes every trace of the answer from the same rewrite, including accented spellings, spellings written letter by letter, and fragments such as “, D.C.”, and a rewrite that consists of the answer alone becomes the neutral “the answer”.

The generators therefore can write, and what post-training cannot add is the reasoning. On Instruction , FLUX.3-klein writes a new word backwards, a trained rule, on 92% of items and drops its first letter, an unseen rule, on 0%. blocks.en: Training problems are generated during training, and test sets are fixed and built to prevent memorization. Expressions have operands from 1 to 9 with probability 80% and from 10 to 20 otherwise, with 1 to 4 operations in training and 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, and 8 operations in testing. Each frame performs one operation, the leftmost multiplication first and then from left to right. Multiplication uses up to 3 × \times 3 digits in training, exactly 3 × \times 3 digits in testing, and 4 × \times 4 digits in the scaling ladder. Each frame writes one partial product, right aligned and shifted, and the last frame writes the sum. In Word Problems , a person starts with 2 to 60 objects, and each sentence adds, removes, multiplies, or halves them. Training uses made-up names, and testing uses real names that training never showed. Word Problems use a 256 × \times 256 canvas, with 32 columns and 16 rows of cells, and a batch of 128, since three-step problems need more rows. Factual Questions use a knowledge base of 300 people, each with a city, a job, and a mother, and cities belong to countries. All single facts are trained. Two-hop questions about the country, the mother’s city, or the mother’s job, and three-hop questions about the mother’s country, are trained for half of the people and tested on the other half. In Curve Tracing , K curves connect letters on the left to numbers on the right and cross each other, and each frame inks a quarter of the asked curve. In Trace Then Sum , the notes “B=4” and “E=7” are written between the inked curves, and the last frame writes the sum. Mazes are n × \times n grids of free cells and holes, with 3 ≤ n ≤ 5 3\leq n\leq 5 , a start S, and a goal G, under the question “Path from S to G:”. Each frame inks one more cell of the path and writes its move, R, D, L, or U, on the note row, and the last frame writes all moves in the answer box. The default demonstration is the breadth-first shortest path with ties broken in a fixed order. Direct answering draws the whole path and writes the moves in one frame. Sum Mazes hold a digit from 1 to 9 in every free cell except S and G. Each frame moves one cell along a shortest path, writes the move on the note row, and updates the running total, and the last frame writes the total in the answer box. Count Then Paint shows three irregular regions in distinct greys, each with a letter and 1 to 6 dots. Each frame circles one dot and updates the count, as in A1, A2, A3, A3 B1, and so on, and the last frames write the chosen letter, box the label with that letter, and paint the boxed region. Counterfactual letters in training, where the written letter is replaced at random and the target paints its region, tie the painted region to the written letter. In Compute Then Paint , the question is an expression such as “paint where dots = 7 − - 2”. The first frame writes the result 7 − - 2=5, and each following frame circles one dot and updates the count, as in A1, A2, …, A5 B1 C3. After the counts, one frame per region appends + if its count equals the result and − - otherwise, as in A − - B+ C − - , and the letter copies the region marked +. The last frames box the label and paint the region, so a problem takes 13 to 22 frames, 17.7 on average.
blocks.zh: 在培训过程中产生培训问题,并固定和建造测试装置以防止记忆。 表达式的操作率从1到9,概率为80%,另外从10到20,其中1到4个操作用于培训,1,2,3,4,6和8个操作用于测试. 每个帧执行一个操作,最左边的乘法先从左到右. 乘法在训练中最多使用3×时的3位数,在测试中精确使用3×时的3位数,在缩放阶梯中使用4×时的4位数. 每个帧写一个部分产品,右对齐和转动,最后一个帧写总和. 在Word Problems中,一个人从2到60个对象开始,每个句子都添加,删除,乘数,或者将它们减半. 训练使用编造的名称,测试使用训练从未显示的真名. Word Problems使用256×\times 256画布,有32列和16列单元格,以及一批128个,因为三步问题需要更多行. 事实问题使用300人的知识库,每个知识库都有城市,工作,母亲,城市属于国家. 所有事实都经过训练。 关于国家,母城,或母职的双跳问题,以及关于母乡的三跳问题,都为一半的人训练,对另一半进行测试. 在曲线追踪(Curve Tracking)中,K曲线将左侧的字母连接到右侧的数字上并相互交叉,每个帧都墨迹为所请求曲线的四分之一. 在 Trace Then Sum中,“B=4”和“E=7”两个笔记是在插孔曲线之间写成的,最后一个框写着这个笔记。 Mazes是n ×\times n 网格的自由细胞和孔,在“从S到G的平面:”题下,有 3 ^ n 5 3\leq n\leq 5,一个起始S,和一个目标G。 每个帧在路径中再插入一个单元格并将其移动,R,D,L,或U,写在注释行上,最后一个帧在回答框中写下所有移动. 默认的演示是宽度第一最短的路径,其连接按固定顺序断裂. 直接回答绘制整个路径,并将动作写在一个框中. Sum Mazes在除S和G外的每个自由细胞中都持有1到9位数. 每个帧沿一个最短的路径移动一个单元格,在音符行上写入动作,并更新运行的总计,最后一个帧在回答框中写入总计. Counter Then Paint以明显的灰色显示三个不规则区域,每个区域有一个字母和1到6个点. 每个帧环绕一个点并更新计数,如A1,A2,A3,A3 B1等,最后的帧写上所选字母,用该字母框装标签,并画出框区域. 训练中的反事实字母,即任意替换书面字母,目标涂抹其区域,将绘画区域与书面字母挂钩. 在“计算然后绘画”中,问题是一个表达式,如“绘出点=7−−2的地方”。 第一帧写出结果 7− - 2=5,每帧后一个圆点并更新计数,如A1,A2,......,A5 B1 C3中. 计数后,每个区域有一个框,如果其计数等于结果,则+--,否则,如A−-B+C−-,字母复制标记为+的区域. 最后一个框框 标签和油漆的区域, 所以一个问题需要13到22帧,平均17.7。

blocks.en: All pixel models use the recipe of Table 6 . The 458M models are trained with data parallelism on 2 to 4 GPUs at the same global batch. In frame-by-frame training, the input canvas is perturbed with Gaussian noise of standard deviation 0.03, so that the rollout tolerates its own small errors. The scaling ladders train for 132k steps, with the learning rate decayed linearly to zero over the last 4k steps. In Section 6 , models compared at equal training run 40k steps, with a constant learning rate after warm-up on Expressions and Word Problems , a cool-down from 20k steps on Count Then Paint , and from 36k steps on Sum Mazes , Trace Then Sum , and Compute Then Paint . The longer runs train for 160k steps with a cool-down from 152k steps. Trace Then Sum starts from a Curve Tracing model trained for 40k steps at a constant learning rate, and Compute Then Paint from the Count Then Paint model of the same answering mode. On the cross-modal tasks the loss weighs the pixels a step changes 31 times more than the copied ones, except for the Curve Tracing model that initializes Trace Then Sum . The joint cross-modal ladder draws 88 examples per task in every step, a batch of 264.

blocks.en: Appendix G Evaluation of the pixel models
blocks.zh: 附录G 对像素模型的评价

blocks.en: Answers are read from pixels, with no judge model. Each 8 × \times 16 cell of the answer rows is matched to the nearest glyph of the font, and an answer is correct only if the whole string matches. Frame-by-frame rollouts start from the original problem canvas and generate each frame from the previous one with the deterministic Euler sampler, with 30 steps on the text tasks and 10 steps on the cross-modal tasks and for the per-step error of Section 5 . In Section 6 , a frame-by-frame rollout runs for the number of frames of the demonstration and the answer is read from the last frame, except on Sum Mazes , where the rollout stops at the first frame whose answer rows are not blank, or after 22 frames. In Section 7 , where the number of frames is the model’s choice, every rollout stops at the first frame with a non-blank answer, or after 10 frames on Expressions , 8 on Word Problems for GRPO and 10 for the other runs, 22 on Sum Mazes , and 32 on the other cross-modal tasks. Direct answering generates a single frame. Trace Then Sum is correct when the sum in the answer box is exact, and Sum Mazes when the moves written on the note row are the demonstrated path and the total in the answer box is its total. Count Then Paint and Compute Then Paint are correct when the letter is right, the note row is right, which for Compute Then Paint includes the result and the + and − - marks, and the painted pixels overlap the true region with an IoU of at least 0.8. Direct answering writes no counts, so only the letter and the painting are checked. In the RL comparison of Section 7 , a cross-modal problem counts as solved only when it is solved in the fewest frames, which on Sum Mazes means a shortest path whose own total is written in the answer box. Every accuracy of the pixel models in the main text is measured on 1,024 problems per test set, generated with a fixed seed, and all compared runs see the same problems. The per-step error of Section 5 uses 4,096 fixed transitions per test set. The model generates the next frame from a correct canvas. On text tasks the step is wrong if any cell reads back wrong, and on Curve Tracing it is wrong if the changed pixels have an IoU below 0.8 with the true change.

blocks.en: Method. The per-step error of the text tasks is the mean over four-step Expressions , 4 × \times 4-digit Multiplication , and Factual Questions , the last averaged over four sets of new entities, with 4,096 transitions per test set. On Curve Tracing it is the share of transitions whose changed pixels have an IoU below 0.8 with the true change, 4,096 per test set, averaged over the sets with 2, 4, 6, and 8 curves. For each size we take the median over five seeds and fit a straight line to log error against log non-embedding parameters N, so that the error is A ⋅ \cdot N − - α \alpha . The held-out check fits only 7.6M to 130M and extrapolates to 458M, with relative error = measured / predicted − - 1. The 90% interval comes from a seed bootstrap with 4,000 draws. In each draw we resample the five seeds of every size with replacement, take the medians, fit again, and predict 458M, and the interval spans the 5th to the 95th percentile of the predictions. In the same way we resample the five seeds of the 458M model to obtain the 90% interval of its measured median, and resample all sizes together to obtain the 90% interval of the relative error. The measured 458M median lies inside the predicted 90% interval for the text tasks, and the two intervals overlap for Curve Tracing , so the law fitted on models up to 130M predicts the held-out 458M model.
